description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC module. It includes class declarations, method signatures for client connection management, and factory creation methods.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the MediaKeys Capabilities Module Service, handling client connection and disconnection.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService, given a reference to an ICdmService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client connects to the IPC service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client disconnects from the IPC service.
